description: Untouched Qwen model-selection holdout created after the context-reranking prompt was frozen. Run once; do not tune against these cases.

cases.description: Select exactly the two facts addressed by a compound planning request.
cases.message: Help me protect my quiet mornings while preparing for the Berlin half marathon.

candidates.content: The user values having quiet mornings without meetings.
The user plans to run the Berlin half marathon.
The user wants to prepare meals on Sundays.

cases.description: A stable factual lesson needs no unrelated personal context.

candidates.content: The user enjoys traveling in autumn.
The user dislikes very hot weather.

cases.description: Use an indirectly phrased value in a related role decision.
cases.message: Would managing my own schedule make this offer a better fit?

candidates.content: The user values control over when they work.
The user takes a train to their current office.

cases.description: Select only the requested fact about the named person.
cases.message: What boundary did I set with Omar about weekend calls?

candidates.content: The user asked Omar not to call about work on weekends.
Omar is the user's former manager.

cases.description: Match a German paraphrase to the exact stored preference.
cases.message: Wie wollte ich schwieriges Feedback erhalten?

candidates.content: The user prefers receiving difficult feedback privately.
The user likes writing feedback for colleagues.

cases.description: Never select a superseded exact goal or a merely related active fact.
cases.message: Was moving to Vienna still my plan?

candidates.content: The user plans to move to Vienna.
The user wants to visit Vienna for a weekend.

cases.description: A contradicted preference remains useful for understanding the contrast.
cases.message: Why am I volunteering to lead when I usually avoid public attention?

candidates.content: The user prefers not to be the center of attention.
The user volunteers at an animal shelter.

cases.description: Select a causal recurring pattern, not generic preparation advice.
cases.message: Why do I delay sending applications after I finish them?

candidates.content: The user postpones submitting completed applications because they fear rejection.
The user likes using checklists for complex tasks.

cases.description: Respect the limit by choosing the most directly requested current goal.
cases.message: Remind me what certification I am studying for.

candidates.content: The user is studying for a cloud architecture certification.
The user wants to complete an advanced Python course.

cases.description: Reject a same-type relationship concerning another person.
cases.message: How can I repair trust with my cousin Leila?

candidates.content: The user and their cousin Leila stopped speaking after an argument about money.
The user trusts their friend Sam with financial questions.

cases.description: A farewell requires no personalized context.

candidates.content: The user prefers phone calls to text messages.

cases.description: Select a scoped health-adjacent exercise preference without unrelated goals.
cases.message: What kind of movement did I say feels manageable after work?

candidates.content: The user finds a short walk manageable after work.
The user wants to build upper-body strength.
The user wants to improve sleep quality.
